description: This Java source file defines activities related to local services in an Android application. It includes a Controller activity for starting/stopping a local service, and a Binding activity for binding/unbinding to the service, demonstrating fundamental Android service management techniques.

classes.name: LocalServiceActivities
classes.description: Contains nested activities for controlling and binding to a local service.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Activity that demonstrates starting and stopping a local service explicitly.

classes.name: Binding
classes.description: Activity that demonstrates binding and unbinding to a local service to communicate with it.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activities, setting the content view and binding button click listeners.

methods.name: doBindService
methods.description: Attempts to bind to the local service.

methods.name: doUnbindService
methods.description: Unbinds from the local service if bound.
